The EPOS H3 Hybrid is on sale for just $24.99 at Woot , a whopping 75 percent off its original price of $99.99. It has an unorthodox batch of features: USB-A and 3.5mm options for connecting to a controller or a PC, and Bluetooth support for listening to music and taking calls. Notably, it can play audio from wired and wireless sources concurrently, and it can last up to 37 hours per charge. EPOS H3 Hybrid Where to Buy: $99.99 $24.99 at Woot My colleague Cameron Faulkner spent some time with the wired-only version of this headset five years ago, and was impressed by its balanced sound profile, comfortable fit, and generously-sized volume knob. He had some qualms about USB connectivity and lack of sidetone, both of which seem to have been addressed in the Hybrid version of the headset that’s available at a steep discount right now. This version also has two microphones — a removable boom mic and a built-in microphone — so you can still take calls via Bluetooth without looking like an airline pilot. ]]> Sean Hollister https://www.theverge.com/?p=971963 2026-07-28T16:35:20-04:00 2026-07-28T15:12:48-04:00 In June, Nintendo announced a new version of the Switch 2 that should let you easily replace its battery pack - but only for Europe.
